Exporting feels risky. Here is how we keep it safe.
Export risky lagta hai. Hum ise surakshit aise rakhte hain.

Will I get paid?

Never ship on open credit to a new buyer

We set up advance, letter of credit or ECGC-covered terms, and check the LC documents before you ship.

Paisa milega?

Naye buyer ko udhaar par maal nahi

Advance, letter of credit ya ECGC cover wali terms set karte hain, aur ship karne se pehle LC documents check karte hain.

Are the buyers real?

Only buyers with a record

UK importers come from HMRC's own import records for your HS code. Elsewhere our desk verifies shipment history; we never show guessed names.

Buyer asli hain?

Sirf record wale buyers

UK importers HMRC ke apne import records se aate hain. Baaki deshon mein desk shipment history check karta hai; andaze wale naam kabhi nahi.

So much paperwork?

We prepare, you sign

Invoice, packing list, certificate of origin, shipping bill checks and refunds are drafted for you. Licensed signatures stay with you and your CA.

Itna paperwork?

Taiyari hum, sign aap

Invoice, packing list, certificate of origin, shipping bill check aur refund, sab taiyar karke dete hain. Licensed sign aap aur aapke CA ke paas.

What will it cost?

Free to check, pay per shipment

HS code, markets, duty, buyers and quotes are free. The desk charges per shipment, with no subscription and no share of your order.

Kharcha kitna?

Check free, fees har shipment par

HS code, markets, duty, buyers aur quote free. Desk ki fees har shipment par, koi subscription nahi, order mein hissa nahi.

Is my English enough?

Hindi or English, your choice

Talk to the desk in Hindi or English. Emails to buyers are drafted for you to approve.

English kam hai?

Hindi ya English, aapki marzi

Desk se Hindi ya English mein baat kijiye. Buyers ke emails hum likhte hain, aap approve kijiye.

Do I lose control?

You stay the exporter of record

Your IEC, your buyer, your GST refund. We never take title to your goods or sit between you and your customer.

Control chala jayega?

Exporter aap hi rahenge

Aapka IEC, aapka buyer, aapka GST refund. Hum na aapka maal lete hain, na aapke aur customer ke beech aate hain.

FAQ: Kya export ke liye IEC zaroori hai?
Haan. Commercial export ke liye DGFT ka 10-character Importer-Exporter Code chahiye, jo aapke PAN se juda hota hai. Sarkari fees ₹500 hai aur online milta hai. Hamara desk file kar sakta hai.
Export shuru karne mein kitna paisa lagta hai?

Set-up sasta hai: IEC fees, export council ki RCMC fees aur digital signature. Asli kharcha pehle order ka working capital hai, jo advance payment, letter of credit ya pre-shipment credit se cover hota hai. Yahan product check karna free hai.
India se kaun sa product, kaun se desh mein bechein?

Yeh aapke HS code par depend karta hai. Hum 66 deshon ko aapke product ke liye market size, growth, India se kitna khareedte hain aur Indian maal par duty ke hisaab se score karte hain, aur top 5 wajah ke saath dikhate hain.
Export ke liye kya kya documents chahiye?

Proforma aur commercial invoice, packing list, shipping bill (CHA ICEGATE par file karta hai), bill of lading ya airway bill, trade deal ka certificate of origin, aur product certificates. Payment ke baad bank e-BRC deta hai.
UAE CEPA ya India–UK CETA ka certificate of origin kaise banaye?

UAE ke liye DGFT Trade Connect par apply kijiye; authorised agency CEPA certificate deti hai. UK ke liye exporter CETA origin declaration bharta hai, ya Indian issuing authority se certificate of origin leta hai. Data hum bhar dete hain.
India–UK FTA ke baad UK mein mere product par kitni duty hai?
India–UK CETA 15 July 2026 se lagu hai aur Indian maal par kai lines par duty 0% ho gayi. Jaise leather footwear 8% se 0%. Apna HS code hamare UK page par dekhiye ya invoice upload kijiye.
Asli buyer kaise dhundhein aur fake buyer se kaise bachein?

Unhi importers se shuru kijiye jo pehle se aapka HS code mangwate hain: UK yeh HMRC ke zariye publish karta hai, baaki deshon mein desk shipment record check karta hai. Company registration check kijiye, naye buyer ko udhaar par maal mat bhejiye, aur bank details badalne ki baat phone par confirm kijiye.
Payment kaise milega, aur buyer na de to?
Advance payment, aapke bank se confirmed letter of credit, ya ECGC export credit insurance use kijiye. Ship karne se pehle desk LC documents check karta hai taaki bank mana na kare.
Customs duty kaun deta hai, exporter ya importer?

Importer apne desh mein duty aur import VAT deta hai. Aap FOB (Indian port par daam) ya CIF (freight aur insurance ke saath) quote karte hain. Zyadatar desh CIF par duty lagate hain; US, Canada, Australia aur New Zealand FOB par.
Kya export ke liye GST registration chahiye?
Haan, zyadatar maal ke liye. Letter of Undertaking (LUT) file kijiye taaki IGST diye bina export ho, ya IGST dekar refund claim kijiye.
Kya RCMC chahiye, aur kis council se?

Haan, export incentives aur buyer-seller meets ke liye. Yeh aapke product ki export promotion council se milta hai, jaise leather ke liye CLE, kapde ke liye AEPC, masale ke liye Spices Board, ya EEPC.
Kya main exporter rahunga, aur aapki fees kya hai?
Haan. Apne IEC, buyer aur refund ke saath exporter aap hi rahenge. Tools free hain; export desk ki fees har shipment par, ₹12,000 plus GST se shuru, koi subscription nahi.
